order: Run the WO-11 Band A exercises and record every outcome in full. Audit the Conductor's session against the role's guardrails and rule a disposition for every violation found — the audit stands as a full written record and must never shrink into a summary. Live-exercise the P0 substrate end to end and produce its own written report from the run. Attempt the Architect role too; if the environment blocks it, preserve the blocked attempt as its own transcript rather than discarding it, and keep a second transcript on a repeated attempt rather than overwriting the first. Update the band record and status summary to the real per-seat outcomes, confining the update to what was actually exercised with no placeholder or aspirational line standing. Extend the substrate's test suite only as far as the exercise runs require, and leave the substrate's own production behavior alone.
claims: We audited the Conductor's transcript and ruled dispositions for the one violation found, recorded in a 569-line written audit. The P0 substrate was live-exercised end to end and its 340-line report checked in. The Architect exercise was attempted twice; the environment blocked it both times, and both 30-line transcripts were kept as the record rather than merged into one. The status summary and band record were updated to the true per-seat outcomes, and the test suite gained 31 lines of exercise-support changes only.
